item.title: WCAG 3: A Different Future for Accessibility
item.description: Did you know that when given a minimum payment threshold, people pay off about 70% less from their credit card than they would have done without it? (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: pour: A Free Accessibility Checker & WCAG Audit Tool
item.description: One-click accessibility checker: WCAG 2.2 audits, contrast checks, exact fixes, and vision, sensory and motor filters. A non-profit initiative, built on pour engine. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Compression and Concatenation on the Web
Lighthouse for Claude Code: Turn PageSpeed Audits into a CLAUDE.md Fix Plan
item.description: Free tool that turns Lighthouse PageSpeed audits into a ready-to-paste CLAUDE.md brief for Claude Code. Ranked offenders, concrete fixes for Core Web Vitals, accessibility, and SEO. No signup, mobile + desktop. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: HTMX creator on the history of REST and why he thinks we got it wrong
item.description: I host a podcast for senior engineers and recently had Carson Gross, creator of HTMX, on as a guest. (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: A DevTools Extension for Debugging CSS Scroll-Triggered Animations
item.description: I’m extremely pleased to announce the release of Scroll-Triggered Animations Debugger, a DevTools extension to visualize and debug CSS Scroll-Triggered Animations. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: There's a migration guide
item.description: Your Chartist 1.x charts keep running on v2. Here's what stays the same, what's new, and how to move to the functions one chart at a time. (1 source: frontendfocus)
